vivienne.story: For the woman who leaves room for the unexpected. The Vivienne pairs a softly slouching leather body with rolled handles, a braided upper edge and warm gold accents. Its relaxed folds bring an easy warmth to a tailored coat, a familiar pair of jeans, and whatever the afternoon becomes.
vivienne.quality: Vegetable-tanned leather gives the Vivienne its tactile character. Look closely at the grain, the smoother trim and the stitching that follows each curve: the interest lies in how the surfaces meet, with enough softness for the silhouette to settle naturally.
vivienne.details: Two rolled top handles sit above a softly folded body, with a braided upper edge, inward-falling belt details and warm gold-tone fittings. The approximate dimensions are 38 × 27 × 20 cm (W × H × D).
vivienne.care: Wipe the leather with a soft, dry cloth. Keep it away from prolonged moisture, direct heat and sunlight, and store it loosely filled to support its shape.

colette.story: The Colette belongs to crisp mornings, long lunches and the coat you return to every autumn. A softly structured brushed-wool body meets smooth leather at the handles and belted front, with warm gold details catching the light. Tactile and quietly expressive, it brings a little softness to a full day.
colette.quality: The character begins with contrast: a short, matte wool nap against smooth leather-wrapped handle arcs. Tonal seams follow the body, while the curved belt ends finish in small gold-tone caps. Each texture has room to be felt and seen.
colette.details: An open top and broad side gussets give the Colette its generous silhouette. Leather wraps the upper handle arcs, and the front belt ends fall separately, each finished with a round gold-tone cap. Approximate dimensions are 50 × 26 × 18 cm (W × H × D), with a 16 cm handle drop.
colette.care: Brush the wool gently with a soft garment brush, following the nap. Spot-clean with a barely damp cloth and let it dry naturally. Wipe the leather trim with a dry cloth and store the bag away from direct heat and sunlight.

weekender.story: For the Friday departure and the invitation that becomes a weekend away. The Eleanor has the presence of a travel bag with the considered details of a favorite handbag: rolled handles, a broad leather flap and a generous silhouette. It feels as natural beside a wool coat as it does at the end of a sunlit platform.
weekender.quality: Canvas brings a close, tactile weave to Cognac, Army Green and Espresso, framed by smooth leather at the flap, handles and corners. Black is all leather. The contrast between substantial panels, neat seams and warm hardware gives each color its own character.
weekender.material: Canvas and leather; Black all leather
weekender.details: The Eleanor has a broad fold-over flap, rolled top handles and leather corner reinforcements. Cognac, Army Green and Espresso combine canvas with leather; Black has an all-leather exterior. Approximate dimensions are 18 × 14.5 × 7 inches (W × H × D).
weekender.care: For Cognac, Army Green and Espresso, spot-clean the canvas carefully with a barely damp cloth and wipe the leather dry. For Black, use a soft, dry cloth across the leather exterior. Allow moisture to dry naturally, away from direct heat, and store loosely filled.

delphine.story: The Delphine moves easily from the first coffee to the last table of the evening. Textured canvas and burnished leather give its compact shape a warm, collected character, while rolled handles and gold-tone fittings lend a little formality. A bag for the woman whose plans rarely end where they began.
delphine.quality: Substantial diagonal canvas twill meets smooth leather at the flap, side gussets and curved corners. The change in texture gives the compact silhouette its depth, while visible stitching traces the handles and edges with a clear, deliberate line.
delphine.details: Rolled top handles and a detachable long strap offer different ways to carry the Delphine. Leather side gussets, curved corner patches and low-hanging slotted gold-tone fittings define the exterior. Approximate dimensions are 25 × 22 × 14 cm (W × H × D).
delphine.care: Spot-clean the canvas with a soft, barely damp cloth. Wipe the leather with a dry cloth, keeping moisture away from the edges and fittings. Let the bag dry naturally and store loosely filled, away from direct sunlight.

juliette.story: A bookshop afternoon, a soft knit, plans left open. The Juliette brings suede and smooth leather together in a generous, gently slouching shape. Short rolled handles, loose front ties and warm brass-tone accents give it a thoughtful informality, for the woman who makes an ordinary day her own.
juliette.quality: The suede nap catches light softly, changing in depth as the surface turns. A smooth leather collar and corner caps frame that texture, while the open top and natural folds keep the silhouette relaxed. The contrast is quiet, but unmistakable up close.
juliette.details: An open top, tall leather collar and short rolled handles define the Juliette. A decorative front strap, loose leather tails and brass-tone accents sit above the soft suede body. Carry it in the hand or over the forearm. The approximate overall specification is 18.5 × 18.5 × 8 inches.
juliette.care: Brush the suede gently with a soft, dry suede brush, following the nap. Wipe leather trim with a separate dry cloth. Avoid water and direct heat, and store loosely filled to support the collar and natural shape.

meridian-tote.story: The Meridian has a composed kind of ease. A softly structured shape, pebbled leather and silver-tone accents bring definition without feeling formal. From a morning appointment to a table booked for two, it suits the woman who likes her everyday pieces to feel considered.
meridian-tote.quality: The pebbled surface gives the color depth, while flat stitched handles and finished edges draw a clean outline. Folded side gussets soften the shape, and cool silver-tone fittings add a small point of light against the leather.
meridian-tote.details: The Meridian combines an open top with short, flat handles, folded side gussets and silver-tone front fittings. Inside, a central zipped compartment separates two open sections. Approximate dimensions are 37 × 24 × 15 cm (W × H × D).
meridian-tote.care: Wipe the leather with a soft, dry cloth. Keep it away from prolonged moisture, direct heat and sunlight, and store it loosely filled to support its shape.

boat-tote-2.story: The Camille is made for a day that takes the scenic route. Sturdy canvas, contrasting trim and a familiar boat-tote silhouette feel at home at the market, by the water or beside your desk. Easy to dress around and full of character, it is the bag that becomes part of your routine.
boat-tote-2.quality: The canvas weave remains part of the design, framed by long handles, vertical front bands and a defined base. A slim belt and small gold-tone fitting bring a more dressed touch to its practical shape. Two-tone and solid colors each retain their own construction details.
boat-tote-2.details: The Camille pairs an open-top canvas body with long handles, front bands and a belted detail. Approximate dimensions are 20 × 14 × 8 inches (W × H × D), with an approximately 10-inch handle drop. Construction varies between two-tone and solid colorways.
boat-tote-2.care: Spot-clean the canvas with a soft, barely damp cloth and mild soap where needed. Avoid soaking the trim or hardware. Air-dry fully away from direct heat and store upright in a cool, dry place.

bag-scarf.story: A small flourish with a feeling all its own. The Bag Scarf adds movement and color to a familiar handle, with a soft drape that makes a simple knot feel considered. Choose the print that feels like you, then carry it your way.
bag-scarf.quality: Thin hems, fluid folds and a gentle sheen let the printed pattern take the lead.
bag-scarf.details: A lightweight printed scarf for styling around a bag handle. Each colorway has its own pattern and border details.
bag-scarf.care: Spot-clean gently or use a professional cleaner. Store flat or loosely rolled, away from direct sunlight.

bag-organizer.story: A calmer beginning to a busy day. The Bag Organizer gives the small things a place of their own, from the keys you need first to the essentials you like close by. Its soft, structured felt brings order to a favorite tote without changing what you love about it.
bag-organizer.quality: Thick matte felt, stitched edges and distinct pocket divisions create a tidy interior with a soft touch.
bag-organizer.details: An open-top felt insert with slip pockets and a central zipped divider. Choose Small, Medium or Large using the size selector, and compare those dimensions with your bag’s interior before ordering.
bag-organizer.care: Empty the organizer, spot-clean with a damp cloth and let it air-dry completely. Reshape gently before returning it to your bag.

horse-charm.story: A playful nod to equestrian style. The Horse Charm adds a little movement and personality to a favorite bag, with a familiar silhouette that feels collected rather than formal. A small detail for the woman who always makes a look her own.
horse-charm.quality: A softly padded profile and carefully shaped details give the little horse its character.
horse-charm.details: A horse-shaped bag charm with attachment and decorative details that vary by colorway. Follow the selected color’s photographs for the exact finish and shape.
horse-charm.care: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid prolonged moisture and store without compressing the padded shape.

cherry-charm.story: A little mischief for an everyday bag. The Cherry Charm brings a playful fruit silhouette and a touch of shine to the handle you reach for most. It is a small, personal flourish that makes even the simplest outfit feel more like yours.
cherry-charm.quality: Rounded cherry forms and a shaped leaf give the charm its recognizable outline, with a finish specific to each colorway.
cherry-charm.details: A paired-cherry bag charm with a leaf detail and attachment hardware. Shape, surface and hardware finish vary by colorway; the selected photographs show the version you are choosing.
cherry-charm.care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth and avoid soaking, perfume and abrasive cleaners.

boat-tote-keychain.story: A favorite shape, made small. The Boat Tote Keychain carries the familiar contrast trim and belted front of a tote into a playful everyday keepsake. Add it to your keys or a bag for a little character that travels with you.
boat-tote-keychain.quality: Tiny handles, a textured body and contrast trim give the miniature its charm, finished with a short chain and a gold-tone ring.
boat-tote-keychain.details: A miniature tote charm attached by a short chain to a round key ring. Its small belt, handles and fittings belong to the miniature design.
boat-tote-keychain.care: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Keep it away from prolonged moisture and avoid pulling on the miniature handles.
